spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/xray"} |= `$client` |= `$dsthost` |= ` accepted ` | pattern `<_> from <src> accepted <dst> [<route>]` | route != "" | label_format inbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll " (>>|->) .*$" .route "" }}`, outbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.* (>>|->) " .route "" }}` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Connections by client
spec.description: The legend names the inbound by its tag in the Xray config.

spec.expr: sum by (client, inbound) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/xray"} |= `$client` |= `$dsthost` |= ` accepted ` | pattern `<_> from <src> accepted <dst> [<route>]` | route != "" | label_format inbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll " (>>|->) .*$" .route "" }}`, outbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.* (>>|->) " .route "" }}` | label_format client=`{{ regexReplaceAll ":[0-9]+$" (regexReplaceAll "^(tcp:|udp:)" .src "") "" }}` [$__auto]))

spec.title: Destinations by client
spec.description: Top 40 destination-and-client pairs. A busy client reaches several times that many destinations, so narrow `Client` to see one client's full list rather than its share of the global ranking.

spec.expr: topk(40, sum by (host, client) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/xray"} |= `$client` |= `$dsthost` |= ` accepted ` | pattern `<_> from <src> accepted <dst> [<route>]` | route != "" | label_format inbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll " (>>|->) .*$" .route "" }}`, outbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.* (>>|->) " .route "" }}` | label_format client=`{{ regexReplaceAll ":[0-9]+$" (regexReplaceAll "^(tcp:|udp:)" .src "") "" }}` | label_format host=`{{ regexReplaceAll ":[0-9]+$" (regexReplaceAll "/.*$" (regexReplaceAll "^(tcp:|udp:|https?://|//)" .dst "") "") "" }}` [$__range])))

spec.title: Clients
spec.description: Distinct source addresses. The access log records no account name, so HTTP users behind one address count once.

spec.expr: count(count by (client) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/xray"} |= `$client` |= `$dsthost` |= ` accepted ` | pattern `<_> from <src> accepted <dst> [<route>]` | route != "" | label_format inbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll " (>>|->) .*$" .route "" }}`, outbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.* (>>|->) " .route "" }}` | label_format client=`{{ regexReplaceAll ":[0-9]+$" (regexReplaceAll "^(tcp:|udp:)" .src "") "" }}` [$__range]))) or vector(0)
sum by (level, reason) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/xray"} |~ `\[(Error|Warning)\] ` | pattern `<_> [<level>] <_>: <reason> > <_>` | level =~ `Error|Warning` | reason != "" [$__range]))

spec.title: Destinations
spec.description: Distinct destination hosts. A service reached by both name and literal IP counts as two.

spec.expr: count(count by (host) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/xray"} |= `$client` |= `$dsthost` |= ` accepted ` | pattern `<_> from <src> accepted <dst> [<route>]` | route != "" | label_format inbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll " (>>|->) .*$" .route "" }}`, outbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.* (>>|->) " .route "" }}` | label_format host=`{{ regexReplaceAll ":[0-9]+$" (regexReplaceAll "/.*$" (regexReplaceAll "^(tcp:|udp:|https?://|//)" .dst "") "") "" }}` [$__range]))) or vector(0)
{syslog_id="docker/xray"} | detected_level=~"$errors_only" | drop transport, systemd_unit, project, hostname

spec.title: Direct routed
spec.description: Connections a `routing.rules` match sent straight out to the `direct-out` outbound instead of a proxy. 0 means everything was proxied.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/xray"} |= `$client` |= `$dsthost` |= ` accepted ` | pattern `<_> from <src> accepted <dst> [<route>]` | route != "" | label_format inbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll " (>>|->) .*$" .route "" }}`, outbound=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.* (>>|->) " .route "" }}` | outbound=`direct-out` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: Dial and transport failures. Each one is a connection the client did not get.

spec.title: Warnings
spec.description: Recoverable faults. Xray logs its startup banner and deprecation notices at this level too.

spec.name: client
spec.label: Client
spec.description: Client address, matched as a substring of the connection line. Only the connection panels use it.

spec.name: dsthost
spec.label: Destination
spec.description: Destination host, matched as a substring of the connection line. Only the connection panels use it.

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only error and warning lines in the log.
